name: @nuclo/native-ts
description: POC: nuclo apps compiled ahead of time from TypeScript to Swift (UIKit), Kotlin (Android Views) and Rust (GTK 4, GPUI), and bundled for the web. No JavaScript engine ships with a native app.

scripts.web: bun scripts/examples.ts web && bun scripts/serve.ts build/web
scripts.wasm: bun scripts/examples.ts wasm && bun scripts/serve.ts build/wasm
scripts.check:android: bun scripts/examples.ts android && bun src/compiler/cli.ts build test/fixtures/accept.ts --out build/check/fixtures --target android && cd hosts/android && for app in ../../build/check/fixtures/android ../../build/android/*; do rm -rf app/build/kotlin app/build/intermediates/built_in_kotlinc app/build/tmp/kotlin-classes; ./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --offline -q -PnucloSources=../$app || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/runtimes/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/runtimes/rust-wasm/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json
